text: FAA guidance instructs to try to reestablish the control link, and if reestablishment fails, to start emergency or contingency procedures and discontinue flight until inspection. Drone manuals describe configurable failsafe actions on signal loss (RTH, land, or hover), with some models automatically initiating RTH and others offering conditions under which RTH or alternate paths are used; RTH can be triggered by user action, low battery, or signal loss, and some systems may maintain RTH even if RC is restored or switch to alternative routes if vision systems are unsuitable.
